evidence_slice: The Central Lancashire Local Plan 2023-2041 Publication Version, Policy HS2: Housing Allocations Chorley, lists HS2.1 North of Bonds Lane, Adlington with a total site area of 3.40 hectares and 92 dwellings. The three Central Lancashire authorities submitted the plan to the Planning Inspectorate on 30 June 2025. The official CLLP_Map_Main FeatureServer exposes layer 15 named HS2 - Housing Allocations Chorley; the service reports 37 features for that layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700. The latest official examination news page records a post-hearing action plan dated 13 April 2026.
